description: This file defines error handling and response structures for a FastAPI backend. It includes custom exceptions, error response models, and functions to handle various error scenarios, such as domain errors, validation errors, and unexpected exceptions, generating consistent JSON error payloads.

classes.name: DomainError
classes.description: Custom base exception class for domain-specific errors carrying an error code, message, status code, and optional details.

classes.name: _ErrorBody
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the structure of an error payload, including a code, message, optional details, and request ID.

classes.name: _Envelope
classes.description: Wrapper Pydantic model that encapsulates the error body for structured error responses.

methods.name: str _get_or_create_request_id(request: Request)
methods.description: Extracts a request ID from headers or generates a new UUID if none is present.

methods.name: JSONResponse _response_with_request_id( request: Request, status: int, payload: Dict[str, Any], request_id: str )
methods.description: Constructs a JSONResponse with specified status, payload, and includes the request ID in headers.

methods.name: JSONResponse handle_domain_error(request: Request, exc: DomainError)
methods.description: FastAPI handler that formats a domain-specific error into a structured JSON response and logs a warning.

methods.name: JSONResponse handle_validation_error(request: Request, exc: ValidationError)
methods.description: FastAPI handler that formats a Pydantic validation error into a JSON response, logs info.

methods.name: JSONResponse handle_unexpected_error(request: Request, exc: Exception)
methods.description: FastAPI handler that catches unanticipated exceptions, logs full traceback, and returns generic error response.

methods.name: JSONResponse make_error_response( request: Request, *, code: str, message: str, status_code: int = HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, details: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, )
methods.description: Utility to generate a custom error response with specified code, message, status, and optional details.
